summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events solely to declare monthly distributions on its common stock for June 2026. The filing states gross distributions of $0.1600 per share across all share classes, with net amounts ranging from $0.1425 to $0.1600 after stockholder servicing fees. Record date is June 30, 2026; payment on or about July 16, 2026. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic event is reported. This is a routine distribution announcement, not a special situation.
